title.narrative: Transforming Knowledge Governance through Open Science, Science Diplomacy, and Gender Equality in the Maghreb

description.narrative: The workplan aims to promote inclusive and equitable knowledge governance in the Maghreb by strengthening the integration of Open Science principles, Science Diplomacy, and gender equality across regional programming and national policies. In a context marked by rapid scientific transformation, uneven access to knowledge, and persistent gender gaps in science systems, the initiative seeks to foster more open, collaborative, and inclusive approaches to knowledge production and decision-making. Its main objectives are to enhance equitable access to scientific data and research outputs, strengthen regional cooperation through science diplomacy mechanisms, and ensure the meaningful participation of women and underrepresented groups in science, innovation, and policy processes. Key activities will include the development of regional frameworks and policy guidance on Open Science, organization of capacity-building workshops and multi-stakeholder dialogues, support to national institutions in adopting inclusive science policies, promotion of data sharing and research collaboration platforms, and facilitation of networks connecting scientists, policymakers, and civil society actors. Through these efforts, the workplan will contribute to more transparent, participatory, and gender-responsive knowledge systems that support sustainable development and regional cooperation in the Maghreb.
